items.content_html: SummaryTree.chomsky_normal_form() binarizes a parse tree and defaults to right factoring. For a node with N children the right-factor branch repeatedly removes the first element of a working list with list.pop(0), which shifts all remaining elements each time, so binarizing one wide node costs O(N^2). An application that converts an attacker-supplied treebank tree to Chomsky Normal Form can be forced into tens of seconds of single-threaded CPU by one wide flat tree. No authentication or user int
